scenes.tts: You need about ten spinach leaves, coffee filters, a glass jar with a lid that is never used for food again, and adult-only rubbing alcohol and safety glasses.
scenes.narration: You need about ten spinach leaves, coffee filters, a glass jar with a lid that is never used for food again, and adult-only rubbing alcohol and safety glasses.

scenes.tts: Your child cuts filter strips and tears spinach. The adult pours alcohol and mashes. Cap the jar for fifteen to thirty minutes. Then the adult stands a strip in it.
scenes.narration: Your child cuts filter strips and tears spinach. The adult pours alcohol and mashes. Cap the jar for fifteen to thirty minutes. Then the adult stands a strip in it.

scenes.tts: Colors climb the strip over thirty to ninety minutes. Expect a wide green band, and often a thin yellow band.
scenes.narration: Colors climb the strip over thirty to ninety minutes. Expect a wide green band, and often a thin yellow band.

scenes.tts: The adult handles the rubbing alcohol from start to finish. It is poisonous to swallow and catches fire easily. Children look, never touch. Ages five to seven do leaf rubbing instead, with no alcohol.

items.text: Alcohol is adult-only, start to finish
